name: The Yule Fabulous
source:
Agni is on her way home when she decides to stop by a place she always passes by. Maybe today she'll meet someone and finally get around to doing what she's been meaning to do for the past year?

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=24468]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
阿格尼在回家的路上，决定在一个她经常路过的地方停下来。也许今天她会遇到一个人，并最终抽出时间去做她过去一年想做的事情？

[来自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=24468]引理软论坛[/url]]
